stories.title: Rescue teams race to find survivors days after massive earthquake hits Colombia
stories.summary: Rescues of people buried under rubble after a massive earthquake struck Colombia are becoming less frequent three days after the temblor. Local authorities are doing what they can for survivors.

stories.title: Latest inflation report may give the Fed more time for its control efforts
stories.summary: Inflation cooled a bit last month. Gas and grocery prices dipped and the overall cost of living rose more slowly, giving the Federal Reserve some breathing room for inflation control efforts.
